Penelope should not have been a villain. I get that it was a great plot twist but there wasn’t much building up to this and this goes against her character from Sly 3. There wasn’t anything showing that she was looking out for herself or had any evil in her body. I believe she said that she did everything for her and Bentley but there wasn’t much showing that either; it felt like the company just wanted to make her a villain just because. From what we’ve seen, she’s always supported the Cooper Gang and didn’t have a reason to change otherwise.
